say:3:1120321001:0.text: Hmm... I think I'm starting to feel better, Alsa. And... I'm also really hungry... Can we eat soon?
say:3:1120321001:0.source_cn: 唔……阿尔萨姐姐，我现在好像舒服多了……而且肚子饿了！...

say:4:1120321002:1.text: Oh, thank goodness, your appetite is finally coming back! I'll go make you something to eat right now!
say:4:1120321002:1.source_cn: 太好了，你之前一直都没什么胃口，现在终于想吃东西了！我...

say:5:1120321003:1.text: Looks like the potion did its job after all. He looks much better now.
say:5:1120321003:1.source_cn: 看来那药剂有用，这孩子确实好起来了。

say:8:1120321004:1.text: Like I said, his sickness was easy enough to heal. There was no need to worry the way you did!
say:8:1120321004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我早就说过了，这种小问题，轻轻松松就能解决的。你...

say:9:1120321005:1.text: Wait, Smokey! I have to ask... What was the "secret ingredient" that you used to make his potion?
say:9:1120321005:1.source_cn: 等等！阿熏，我有个问题想问你……你的那个“祖传秘方”…...

say:10:1120321006:1.text: W-Well, uh... It's called a secret for a reason, you know!
say:10:1120321006:1.source_cn: 这个……我可不太方便说啊。

say:11:1120321007:1.text: It's a family secret that has been passed down for generations... My business would be ruined if people found out, wouldn't you agree?
say:11:1120321007:1.source_cn: 各位应该也明白吧，这种可是我们看家的本事，万一泄露出去...

say:12:1120321008:1.text: We wouldn't tell a soul, trust us!
say:12:1120321008:1.source_cn: 这个你放心，我们肯定不会说出去的！

say:13:1120321009:1.text: I'm just curious... After all, I tried every single one of the herbs on the list, but they only worked after you added your "secret ingredient"...
say:13:1120321009:1.source_cn: 但是我真的很好奇……明明我们都用的同样的草药，为什么只...

say:14:1120321010:1.text: B-But I... Oh, alright! I'll share my little secret with you, but you have to promise not to tell anyone! Ever!
say:14:1120321010:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这……行吧，那我就偷偷告诉各位了，但你们千万不能...

say:15:1120321011:1.text: If anyone were to find out, I'd be in even more trouble than usual!
say:15:1120321011:1.source_cn: 如果其他人知道了，我真的会出问题的！

choice_prompt:16:1120321011.text: If anyone were to find out, I'd be in even more trouble than usual!
choice_prompt:16:1120321011.source_cn: 如果其他人知道了，我真的会出问题的！

say:17:1120321012:1.text: The secret ingredient... is my blood.
say:17:1120321012:1.source_cn: 其实那个祖传配方，就是从我的血液。

say:18:1120321013:1.text: Your... blood? Is your blood really that potent...?
say:18:1120321013:1.source_cn: 是你的……血？你的血竟然这么厉害……？

say:19:1120321014:1.text: Our blood gives we meerkats a natural resistance to poisons, you see.
say:19:1120321014:1.source_cn: 我们狐獴的血液，可以抗毒。

say:21:1120321016:1.text: But if that's the case, doesn't that mean you have to draw your own blood every time you make a potion? That sounds so painful...
say:21:1120321016:1.source_cn: 不过如果是这样的话，你做药剂的时候，岂不是要抽自己的血...

say:22:1120321017:1.text: It's just a little blood, nothing to worry about! Besides, I have plenty of mouths to feed around here...
say:22:1120321017:1.source_cn: 还好还好，一点血而已，毕竟我还要养这么一大家子……

say:23:1120321018:1.text: I mean, I'm more than happy to give out a little blood to help someone! Hahaha!
say:23:1120321018:1.source_cn: 啊不，我的意思是，毕竟我的血可以帮助到其他人嘛，不辛苦...

say:24:1120321019:1.text: It appears the boy's condition is perfectly stable now, so there's no need for another dose of medicine.
say:24:1120321019:1.source_cn: 现在来看，这孩子的情况差不多已经稳定了，之后就不用再服药了。

say:25:1120321020:1.text: Just remember to watch what he eats! Make sure he doesn't eat anything off the ground, or he'll suffer again!
say:25:1120321020:1.source_cn: 但还是要注意饮食！可不能再随便把什么东西都放进嘴里了，...

say:28:1120321021:0.text: No problem! Thank you, Mr. Genius Apothecary Smokey!
say:28:1120321021:0.source_cn: 知道啦！谢谢天才药剂师阿熏先生！

say:29:1120321022:1.text: We really can't thank you enough, Smokey. I don't know what I would've done without your help...
say:29:1120321022:1.source_cn: 这次真的太感谢你了，阿熏。要不是有你，我还真不知道怎么...

say:32:1120321023:1.text: Don't mention it, don't mention it! I'm honored that I could be of help.
say:32:1120321023:1.source_cn: 哎呀，小事小事！能帮到你们也是在下的荣幸啊。

say:33:1120321024:1.text: And now that this little Mauler seems to be recovering, I really should get going.
say:33:1120321024:1.source_cn: 既然这小蛮血病都好的差不多了，我也是时候该回去了。

say:34:1120321025:1.text: Of course! Let me escort you back!
say:34:1120321025:1.source_cn: 当然当然！我送你回去吧！
